name: B10-0323/2025 (The Left) – Arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese researcher held in the Central African Republic since May 2024. He was detained by the Wagner Group and is in a military prison awaiting trial, facing possible life imprisonment. The Parliament asks the Central African authorities to give him a fair trial without delay or free him, to investigate claims he was tortured, and to make sure he gets medical care. The Parliament is stating its position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the Central African Republic to act.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, his family, and the Central African authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union institutions, member states, and the Central African authorities.
